accepted_family: Every actual T=Tref=15, common stable affine rho_prime(z)=a0+s*z with a1=0, every actual u=U and v=V at both columns/all depths. Actual CV means and PR26 endpoint coefficients coincide only on this uniform-velocity subspace. No general mean-preserving basis claim.

raw_authority: Per-area h,IT,IS,Mu,Mv; u=Mu/(rho0*h). A=d*L/2; r=A*Mu, D=diag(rho0*A*h). h/interfaces/eta and thermodynamic stocks are byte-preserved on the accepted family, with nonzero shared P1 face transport verified to have zero divergence per raw row.
shared_faces: One water Q=L*dz*integral(u dt) and one corresponding P1 IT/IS/Mu/Mv flux per physical face segment are used by both neighbors with opposite signs. Fixed eta implies R_surface=R_bottom=R_internal=0. Q/stock/pressure traction matching only diagnoses/refuses; no repairs.
force: Every raw row pressure force is its two actual face traction integrals. Common segment Pa is averaged once from both actual P1 hydrostatic columns. Fraw must agree with -P*A*h and independent -integral_CV(p_x)dV; Fmu from the PR26 physical basis must equal R*Fraw with R=W*D^-1. This full-vector equality is restricted to uniform-depth external pressure gradient P=(pR-pL)/d.
step: Prepare all five raw authority fields on a copy; actual integrated raw momentum r_after=r_before+dt*Fraw. Compute shared finite-time fluxes using the true pressure acceleration, enforce every raw row water/TS/M ledger, raw/physical force duality and actual before/after work, then commit the complete state once. Any failure leaves state/time/count/last receipt unchanged. No predictor, fast/replay or production default switch.
energy: Fixed eta/mass on accepted steps: actual nodal and physical KE coincide for uniform velocity; midpoint uses true raw M_before/M_after. Independently prove finite pressure boundary work, zero net advective KE/PE flux, unchanged actual PE. Moving-mass algebra is separately tested using actual snapshots: DeltaK=u_mid*DeltaM-0.5*u_after*DeltaMass*u_before for D and W. Moving cases do not count as accepted.
obstructions: Sloped eta same-u B is not conservative: raw momentum and physical momentum differ by4.1 in the frozen PR26 case, IS by50/779, PE by629.17048125J. Flat moving affine flow has a changing nodal-vs-physical KE gap and a nonzero raw-vs-B local storage transfer; existing weighted B flux alone does not close raw rows. Alpha/a1/shear/nonflat refuse.
